local_learn.observation: Revision 15 exposes a structural control-plane gap, not a prompt-length problem. Full raw-context internalization would duplicate authorities, stale silently, increase secret and overload risk, and weaken replay. The higher-value falsifiable design is an O-owned manifest/event control plane over authoritative source references and receipts, with mandatory control context separated from recursively routed optional content.
